scope: Published OpenHands SDK/tools 1.50.0 package closure on Linux x86_64 CPython 3.13.15 only.

baseline.meaning: Historical 832938 review and original successful scan remain unchanged; neither is a fresh independent review of this new lock.

research.patch_chronology: The release backports adapted request-parameter/destination checks; do not infer ancestry from the advisory mainline commit 473f72e.
research.cutoff_instruction: OpenHands/software-agent-sdk@395b94b0c3c4994f6c530f1e3bf3196f71fab950 pyproject.toml:8 says to bump or remove the LiteLLM-specific cutoff when upgrading past 1.93.0.
research.dependency_bounds: dcf401af openhands-sdk/pyproject.toml allows litellm>=1.93.0; LiteLLM1.93.2 base aiohttp>=3.14.2 is satisfied by the retained aiohttp3.14.3 pin.

limitations: Static name/AST review does not prove semantic or dynamic unreachability.
One compiled LiteLLM extension is not assessed by the Python source scan.
No proxy-server, provider, model, image, host deployment or task-quality execution.

sdk_local_fixtures.meaning: Existing repository fixtures against real SDK objects with model calls patched.

unchanged_upstream_module.method: Unmodified module/config, neutral cwd, append import mode and before/after in-process installed LiteLLM identity assertions.
unchanged_upstream_module.limits: Bounded upstream URL helper module only; complete workspace/proxy/authenticated routing and provider execution were not run.

osv.whole_inventory_workflow: Not newly executed here; later exact-step/current-head checks belong to the coordinator.

oauthlib_exact_target_review.caller_conclusion: Six requests_oauthlib client/helper importer files remain; the new LiteLLM Python source scan adds no OAuthlib/advisory-name caller.
oauthlib_exact_target_review.limits: Static name/AST/alias review, with text-only Python2 helper and existing method limits; no semantic/dynamic unreachability or authorization-server trace. One compiled LiteLLM extension is outside the Python source scan.
oauthlib_exact_target_review.independent_current_candidate_review: Pending; historical #558/#537 do not automatically carry to the new digest.

retained_attempts_and_corrections: Original 832938 successful scan remains dated; the new database advisory is retained as a fresh failing baseline, not erased.
A speculative scripts/check_openhands_oauthlib.py read found no file; rg located the actual guard tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py.

Four attempted curl captures were intercepted before execution by the context-mode hook; no native fetch/exit claim uses those calls. Primary responses were then actually captured with native urllib.request, outside model output.

Initial qualification-tool preparation reused pytest8.4.2 from the previous relock. Tagged LiteLLM pyproject pins9.0.3/asyncio1.3; those exact versions were installed before any upstream test execution. The preparation is retained in the ledger.

repository_checks_before_shared_registra.returned_condition: Only SHA/byte-count mismatches for the four owned existing files; the shared evidence index remains at the immutable base and is intentionally coordinator-owned.
repository_checks_before_shared_registra.required_closure: Coordinator registers the owned source/new artifacts and runs fresh validation on the integrated exact head.

publication_private_content_scan.native_command: python3 scripts/validate.py --scan-file <each of the 44 owned files>

complete_staged_whitespace_check.condition: Exactly three SHA-bound original native return artifacts contain trailing whitespace or an original final blank line; their bytes are preserved.

staged_whitespace_excluding_only_the_thr.method: Native git diff --cached --check with exact exclude pathspecs for the three artifacts named above; no repository policy, ignore or artifact bytes changed.

remaining_gates: Fresh independent review of the exact candidate and current required hosted checks.
The unchanged upstream workspace root/uv.lock and pinned image retain earlier LiteLLM; frozen workspace/image execution is not covered by this package compile.
Full-image 56 High/Critical findings, provider/P3, trusted observer, frozen task-quality, compression and whole-task metering remain open.
